author: G. F. Tydeman, station list revised by the ship’s commander, in Max Weber’s 1902 Introduction et description de l’expédition
read_method: Independent visual transcription of the printed register. Fields listed below were checked on the scan in addition to the later gastropod account.

comparisons.locality: Sailus ketjil, Paternoster islands; close to reef
comparisons.interpretation: The site name and depth match the two doubtful historical shells. Coordinates are blank in the printed station register.
The paired locality and depth distinguish 43 from the OCR reading 3 and from suffixed 43-series stations.

comparisons.locality: Bay of Bima, near south fort
comparisons.interpretation: Adjacent entries 47a (320 m) and 47b (296 m) are separate stations.
Date and substrate are shared with the suffixed row. Depth and position differ.
The register resolves the indistinct glyph on Schepman p112, line 30 through the matching 69 m and locality.
Coordinates agree in magnitude with the modern station 89 record, while the latitude hemisphere and the printed day differ.
Independently corroborates day and station number of the Cephalodiscus control. The position printed on row 88 cannot establish coordinates for row 89.
